location: Section 1, 'A plural textual tradition', paragraph beginning 'A focused Asaṅga-commentary study' (line 25)

When Sanskrit ablative relations and the causal force of *nimitta* are retained, *saṃjñā* ceases as its causes change; when those relations are omitted and *nimitta* is rendered only as “form,” the passage can suggest that an ontological object must be destroyed. location: Section 1, 'Doctrine, ritual, and material reception', paragraph beginning 'Two analytical layers' (line 45)
current exact text: Two analytical layers must remain distinct. The earliest recoverable textual-pedagogical structure constrains plausible interpretation. Later performance and material reception show what the scripture meant and did in particular communities. Reception is constitutive of historical meaning, but it does not make every later use equally authoritative for reconstructing the earliest discourse. The redactional history of recitation, writing, merit, and sacred-place passages remains unresolved. Broad early attestation would strengthen the claim that material transmission belongs to the sutra’s earliest doctrinal-practical script. Late or marginal attestation would relocate, not erase, the argument: reception would remain historically constitutive while carrying less weight as evidence for the earliest recoverable dialogue.

location: Section 2, 'Teaching without possessing the teaching', first paragraph (line 75)
current exact text: The sutra turns its method upon Buddhism itself. Dharma and non-dharma are not to be grasped. Attainments, buddha-fields, bodily marks, merit, and even “teaching the Dharma” cannot become achievements owned by a spiritual self. The raft image matters: teachings are used to cross, not carried as permanent identity. Yet one must use the raft. Refusing grasping is not a reason to refuse study, cultivation, or communication. The sequence also blocks easy replacement essences: the Buddha cannot be identified by form or voice, awakening is not a dharma acquired, and even selflessness cannot become a standpoint in which one abides [[vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-gretil]].

location: Section 3, 'Psychological, with strict limits', paragraph beginning 'These findings test modern constructs' (line 118)
current exact text: These findings test modern constructs. They do not measure realization of emptiness, the bodhisattva vow, merit, awakening, or the sutra’s total practice. location: Section 3, 'Psychological, with strict limits', paragraph beginning 'One popular mechanism fails' (line 130)
current exact text: One popular mechanism fails a direct check: a systematic review of standardized eight-week programs found no overall improvement in objective attention or executive function. The chain “meditation improves attention, therefore nonreactivity, therefore every desired outcome” is not universal [[consciousness-and-cognition]]. Safety also requires differentiation. A systematic review reported meditation-related adverse events in 8.3 percent of participants overall, with substantial heterogeneity; anxiety, depression, and cognitive anomalies were common categories [[1011112facps13225]]. That estimate should not be mechanically applied to brief reflection, but intensive practice is not risk-free. Using the sutra only to optimize symptoms, productivity, or a more successful self also turns non-abiding into another possession.

location: Section 4, 'Relate to emotion as information, not identity', safety-screen paragraph (line 161)
current exact text: A provisional safety screen asks whether nonattachment increases emotional contact, clarity, communication, boundaries, repair, and proportionate protection. A harmful lookalike instead produces vagueness, premature forgiveness, dissociation, refusal of conflict, or tolerance of preventable harm [[nonattachment-without-withdrawal-tests-for-spiritual-bypass]]. Preliminary cross-sectional evidence also links emotional restrictiveness and narcissism with distress beyond spiritual identification, so calmness or spiritual self-description is not evidence of integration [[1010022fj2161-007x2010tb00014x]]. location: Section 5, 'Career decisions without self-erasure', first paragraph (line 177)
current exact text: As a contemporary extrapolation, non-abiding separates vocation and performance from an exhaustive professional identity. When choosing work or seeking promotion, ask whether the role serves real needs, whether its harms can be changed, and what compromise it requires. After rejection, job loss, or criticism, preserve the information and practical consequences without converting one evaluation into “I am a failure.” One may prepare, negotiate, compete fairly, and pursue mastery without making status the measure of personhood. Conversely, “letting go” must not disguise suppressed ambition, passive acceptance of exploitation, or refusal to leave unethical work. This guidance derives from non-abiding action and evidence associating self-concept flexibility with well-being, not from a trial of Diamond Sutra-based career decisions [[vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-gretil]] [[frontiers-in-psychology]].

location: Section 5, 'Career decisions without self-erasure', care-work paragraph (line 181)
current exact text: Care work makes the level distinction concrete. A review of 79 studies involving 28,509 nurses found moderate pooled compassion satisfaction, burnout, and secondary traumatic stress, with burdens worsening over time and especially severe estimates in some Asian and intensive-care samples [[international-journal-of-nursing-studies]]. A 71-study healthcare review found compassion fatigue across practitioner groups, with consequences for provider health, effectiveness, and patient care [[nursing-ethics]]. Nonattachment should support sustainable care, recovery, peer support, and boundaries, not sanctify limitless emotional availability. Staffing, traumatic exposure, and organizational duty remain institution-level causes.

location: Section 5, 'Co-option versus right-livelihood business design', first paragraph (line 201)

location: Section 6, 'Parenting: the child is neither possession nor project', condition-specific study paragraph (line 239)
